fonction: Taste buds detect {v:A_GOUTS} tastes: sweet, salty, sour, bitter, umami; signals run in the facial, glossopharyngeal and vagus nerves
Olfactory neurons high in the nasal cavity send axons through the cribriform plate to the olfactory bulb; the only sense that reaches the cortex without a thalamic relay
Eardrum and ossicles pass sound to the cochlea; hair cells of the organ of Corti respond, high pitches near the base, low near the apex; range about {v:A_AUDITION_MIN} to {v:A_AUDITION_MAX} Hz
Utricle and saccule (otoliths): head position and linear acceleration; semicircular canals: rotation; vestibulocochlear nerve
Retina: rods for dim light, three kinds of cones for color; the fovea gives the sharpest vision; the optic disc is the blind spot
